verdict.rationale: Docs confirm the agent can produce JSON output (docs-3, docs-21) and GitHub examples show structured extraction tasks (gh-2), but the Cloud API explicitly returns `run.result` as a raw string with instructions to 'Ask for JSON only, then validate it client-side' — there's no built-in Zod/Pydantic schema enforcement, just a convention plus manual client-side validation. missing for 10: native schema-typed extraction API (e.g. passing a Pydantic/Zod model to constrain output), automatic validation/retry on schema mismatch, and independent confirmation this works reliably in practice.
